## How to obtain

Harvest wild or cultivated berry; young plants return one seed and mature plants return two.

## Using it

Select these seeds and right-click farmland prepared with a hoe. See [Farming and cooking](Farming-and-cooking.md). Hold to attract [Chickens](Chickens.md); right-click an eligible adult to feed one item for breeding.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
